bedrockplacing.missing_mycel: Mycel is missing. %s needs the Mycel library to work and stays off until it is installed.
bedrockplacing.config.enabled.desc: Whether Bedrock-style air-click placement is active.
bedrockplacing.config.sneakDisables.desc: Whether sneaking skips the assist (hold sneak to right-click air normally).
bedrockplacing.config.requireSupport.des: Whether the anchor block under you must have a sturdy side face.
bedrockplacing.config.reach.desc: Maximum eye-to-target distance in blocks for assisted placement.
bedrockplacing.config.preview.desc: Whether to outline the block cell that would be placed (client side).
bedrockplacing.config.repeatTicks.desc: Client ticks between assisted placements while holding right-click (vanilla uses 4).
